Dated: 21.09.2017. 
Sir, 
Please refer to the subject and reference cited above. 
2. 
Vide circular under reference above, it was informed that all the EPF exempted 
establishments having link for filing of online returns will be evaluated on six key parameters 
each month and based on the point secured by the establishments a ranking list will be prepared 
and the same practice is being followed since July, 2017. The performance evaluation cum 
ranking list is prepared on the following parameters -

2. 
Officers' attention is invited towards the performance evaluation cum ranking list of 
exempted establishments for the wage month of February 2018, which was published on the 
official website of EPFO on 06.04.2018 (list may be obtained from the official website of EPFO). 
It has been observed that 675 establishments have secured 300 or less points in the ranking 
system. Out of these 675 establishments 433 establishments have not even filed return for the 
wage month of February 2018 and thus secured zero point in the ranking list. 
3. 
All the six parameters deployed in ranking the establishment are vital parameters and 
can be considered as key parameters for identifying overall health of the Trust and satisfactory 
compliance of the establishment in respect of the provisions of the Act and Scheme. If such 
large number establishments are not able to perform on the aforesaid basic parameters, then 
such establishments and their Trusts are prone to further default and may be found to be 
violating the conditions for grant of exemption. 
4. 
All the field offices are directed to ensure that the up-to-date compliance audit of these 
establishments is conducted at the earliest and if any establishment is found violating the 
conditions for grant of exemption, then strict action as per the Act & Scheme should be taken 
including issuing of Show Cause Notice, prosecution of employer under Section 14 of the Act 
and initiation of cancellation of exemption. 
5. 
It is directed to monitor performance of exempted establishments every month and to 
get the performance of all such establishments improved, which have secured 300 or less points 
in the ranking list. Further, strict actions should be taken against the exempted establishments 
showing lackadaisical approach including cancellation of exemption. 
Yours faithfully 
Central P.F. Commissioner
